name: 31763 · Leesburg, GA
findings: ZIP 31763 (Leesburg) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 31763 (Leesburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 31763 (Leesburg) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
